newsitem.title: USA: Mutual fund flows slow in 2-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: Mutual fund flows slow in 2-day period - survey.

text.p: Equity mutual fund cash flows slowed to $430 million for the two days ended Nov 11, versus $2.22 billion for the three-day period ended Nov 7, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
U.S. funds fell to $474 million in inflows versus $1.83 billion, while international funds had outflows of $44 million versus inflows of $386 million.
Aggressive growth funds dropped to inflows of $132 million versus $678 million.

Bond funds recorded inflows of $66 million versus outflows of $77 million. Muni fund outflows narrowed to $39 million from outflows of $206 million, while high yield funds had inflows of $9 million versus inflows of $124 million.
